node_definition.done_when: Done when. A test runs landing passes over a candidate while the primary revision advances between passes in a temporary repository, in which every pass reaches the conflict check and none lands the candidate, and reads the repository's object set after the passes equal to its set before them plus exactly the objects reachable from the commits the fixture itself wrote to advance the primary revision, so no object the check computed remains. A second test lands a candidate and reads the merge's objects present in the repository. Negative control: the first test at the base revision reads objects beyond the fixture's own remaining after the passes, and the failing run is logged. The gate runs on all_debug and its log is written to the section's evidence fragment.
node_definition.goal: a managed repository's object store stays packed without a hand repack
node_definition.negative_control: the section's done-when names its negative control: the same test run against the base revision fails, and the failing run is logged
